title: Frozen run configuration
description: Snapshot of the run_frozen keys of the run scope taken by StartRun; stored in skm_execution.execution_bundles.config_snapshot.

registry_digest.description: Digest of the versioned registry descriptor: section schemas, defaults, merge/reload/normalization semantics, and enabled modules. Unknown descriptors fail closed before execution.

digest.description: SHA256 of canonical {schema, registry_digest, values}; binds values to their original interpretation.

values.description: key -> effective value; keys absent from the map were absent (nullable) at freeze time.

provenance.description: key -> label of the winning layer (default, pack:<id>, instance, workspace:<slug>, …).
